d.ko: Orebound is a dwarven themed factory automation game. Play alone or with friends as you build, mine, craft and explore a voxel generated world! Build your fortress, expand your factory, fight off creatures who dwell beneath the mountains and embark on a journey of greatness.
d.en: Orebound is a dwarven themed factory automation game. Play alone or with friends as you build, mine, craft and explore a voxel generated world! Build your fortress, expand your factory, fight off creatures who dwell beneath the mountains and embark on a journey of greatness.
d.zh: 踏上寻找余烬石的旅程，它在时间深处迷失。国王命令你在群山中找到它。深入挖掘，自动化采矿，制作物品和符文。将贵重金属和宝石送回你的王国。成长、采矿并找到余烬石。
